{{Short description|Dutch mathematician}}
{{family name hatnote|van der Kallen|Kallen|lang=Dutch}}
'''Wilberd Leo Johan van der Kallen''' (born 15 January 1947 in [[Nieuwer-Amstel]])<ref>{{cite web|title=XI 5 Wilberd van der Kallen|website= deel 10 : Albert (X 7) — wilberdk.home.xs4all.nl|url=https://wilberdk.home.xs4all.nl/publications_files/deel10.pdf}}</ref> is a Dutch mathematician.

W. L. J. van der Kallen completed his undergraduate study of mathematics and physics at [[Utrecht University]].<ref name=gqt>{{cite web|title=Wilberd van der Kallen (with links to publication list)|website= Geometry and Quantum Theory (GQT) (a national Dutch mathematical research cluster)|url=https://www.gqt.nl/for-researchers/members/wilberd-van-der-kallen/}}</ref> There he received his PhD in 1973 with thesis advisor [[T. A. Springer]] and thesis ''Infinitesimally central extensions of Chevalley groups''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|name=Wilberd L. J. van der Kallen|id=49613}}</ref> In 1969 Van der Kallen became a teaching assistant in Utrecht University's Mathematics Department and has spent his career there, eventually becoming a tenured professor. His research deals with algebraic K-theory and the representation theory of algebraic groups, among other topics. He has frequently been a visiting professor at [[Northwestern University]] in [[Evanston, Illinois]] and at the [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]] in [[Mumbai]].<ref name=gqt/>

He is the author or coauthor of over 60 research articles.<ref name=gqt/> In 1977 he published an analogue of a 1977 theorem of [[Andrei Suslin]]<ref>{{cite journal|author=van der Kallen, Wilberd|title=Another presentation for Steinberg groups|journal=Indagationes Mathematicae (Proceedings)|volume=80|issue=4|pages=304–312|year=1977|doi=10.1016/1385-7258(77)90026-9|url=https://webspace.science.uu.nl/~kalle101/another.pdf|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1070/IM1977v011n02ABEH001709|title=On the Structure of the Special Linear Group over Polynomial Rings|year=1977|last1=Suslin|first1=A. A.|journal=Mathematics of the USSR-Izvestiya|volume=11|issue=2|pages=221–238|bibcode=1977IzMat..11..221S}}</ref> and a generalization of a 1969 theorem of [[Hideya Matsumoto]].<ref>{{cite journal|author=van der Kallen, W.|year=1977|title=The <math>K_2</math> of rings with many units|journal=Annales scientifiques de l'École Normale Supérieure|volume=10|issue=4|pages=473–515|doi=10.24033/asens.1334|url=http://www.numdam.org/item/10.24033/asens.1334.pdf|doi-access=free}}</ref> In 1978 Van der Kallen was an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Helsinki.<ref>{{cite book|author=van der Kallen, W.|year=1978|chapter=Generators and relations in algebraic K-theory|chapter-url=https://wilberdk.home.xs4all.nl/publications/GeneratorsRelations.pdf|title=Proceedings of the International Conference of Mathematicians at Helsinki|volume=1|pages=305–310}}</ref> His 1980 paper ''Homology stability for linear groups''<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1007/BF01390018|title=Homology stability for linear groups|year=1980|last1=van der Kallen|first1=Wilberd|journal=Inventiones Mathematicae|volume=60|issue=3|pages=269–295|bibcode=1980InMat..60..269K|s2cid=54671324}}</ref> has over 200 citations. His 1977 paper ''Rational and generic cohomology'', written with 3 other mathematicians,<ref>{{cite journal|author=Cline, Edward|author2=Parshall, Brian|author3=Scott, Leonard|author4=van der Kallen, W.|title=Rational and generic cohomology|journal=Inventiones Mathematicae|volume=39|issue=2|year=1977|pages=143–163|doi=10.1007/BF01390106|s2cid=14358269|url=https://webspace.science.uu.nl/~kalle101/cpsvdk.pdf}}</ref> has over 240 citations.
